<solar/>Scorch and <solar/>Ignitions that originate from this weapon deal 41% increased damage. While Transcendent, this increases to 78.5%.

Landing 5 Sword Hits causes a Solar Explosion dealing <pve 237 /> <pvp [64] /> damage and applying 40 <solar/>Scorch (60 Scorch with <solar/>Ember of Ashes) in a 5 meter radius.
